mentions.name: Deckhand
mentions.description: An AI-assisted, human-in-the-loop platform for shipping and operating mobile apps. It aims to speed up the entire app delivery loop—testing, debugging, reviewing, store submissions, releases, and monitoring—while keeping humans in control of the process.
mentions.problem: While AI has dramatically sped up building mobile apps, everything around the build—testing, debugging, reviewing, store submissions, releases, monitoring, and keeping things running—still takes a surprising amount of human effort.
mentions.audience: Mobile app developers shipping and operating apps
mentions.source_excerpt: We’re building Deckhand (https://getdeckhand.dev), an AI assisted, human in the loop platform for shipping and operating mobile apps.
mentions.author: narayanahari
